tools_helpful.evidence: Seeded the WinUI 3 scaffold, namespace-rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml, and produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md (208 rows).
Caught residue=0, build PASS, smoke-launch PASS; also flagged 208 mapping rows still Status=copied so the agent flipped them (turns 58-60).
Surfaced the exact AppxManifest validation errors (0x80080204 / 0xC00CE169) that pinpointed the background-task manifest placement bug (turns 48,54,57).

tools_problematic.problem: Copies every *.cs recursively from the UWP source including build artifacts under obj/ and bin/ and legacy Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log turn 37: build failed CS0579 'Duplicate TargetFrameworkAttribute' from Tasks\obj\x64\Release\.NETCore,Version=v5.0.AssemblyAttributes.cs.

tool_limitations.limitation: No bin/obj/Properties exclusion at the copy step (the exclusion only applies later, to the namespace-rewrite pass).
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Filter artifact dirs and AssemblyInfo.cs in the copy Where-Object so stale generated sources never land in the project.

failed_apis.why_tried: Agent assumed UWP in-process background-task activation override exists on the WinUI 3 App class.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3 Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no OnBackgroundActivated override and BackgroundActivatedEventArgs is not referenced.
failed_apis.fix: Removed the override; the packaged class is COM-activated via the manifest inProcessServer extension (turns 50-52).

special_apis.special_handling: Must be a PACKAGE-level extension (root <Extensions>, sibling of <Applications>), not nested under <Application>; otherwise AppX registration fails with 0x80080204 / schema enumeration error.

special_apis.api: DataTemplate x:Bind/x:DataType referencing a project type (local:Scenario)
special_apis.special_handling: MarkupCompilePass2 emitted WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly parameter' then WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999; agent worked around by switching the ListBox ItemTemplate to {Binding Title} (turn 46).

errors_encountered.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration copied UWP build artifacts (obj/) and Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs; SDK-style csproj auto-globs them into the build.
errors_encountered.fix: Deleted Tasks/obj, Tasks/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs, bin ilc artifacts and added <Compile Remove> guards (turns 42-43).

errors_encountered.error: CS0246 'MainPage' could not be found in MainWindow.xaml.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold MainWindow navigates to MainPage but the page kept the sample's SDKTemplate namespace; MainWindow lacked 'using SDKTemplate;'.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909/WMC1111 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' in MainPage.xaml DataTemplate
errors_encountered.root_cause: x:Bind DataTemplate against a project type failed during MarkupCompilePass2 (WMC1509 no LocalAssembly).

errors_encountered.error: AppX 0x80080204 — EntryPoint without ActivatableClassId; then 0xC00CE169 schema enumeration violation
errors_encountered.root_cause: windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer placed inside <Application> instead of package root <Extensions>.
errors_encountered.fix: Moved the inProcessServer extension to package-level <Extensions> (turns 49-55).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two build cycles failed on stale UWP build-artifact .cs files compiled into the project (CS0579) plus residual scaffold/namespace errors.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration copied obj/bin/Properties artifacts from the UWP source.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Excluding bin/obj/.vs/Properties-AssemblyInfo at the Initialize-UwpMigration copy step (Tier 1 script).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Three failed build/launch cycles wiring the in-process background task (OnBackgroundActivated CS0246, then two AppX manifest validation failures).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No skill guidance that WinUI 3 App lacks OnBackgroundActivated and that inProcessServer is a package-level manifest extension.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed the override and moved the inProcessServer extension to package root.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Concrete in-process-background-task subsection in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md Background Tasks (Tier 3).

env_issues.issue: Headless session: WinUI composition screenshots are blank and UWP CoreWindow exposes no XAML UIA tree, so per-scenario UWP behavioral baseline could not be captured.
env_issues.workaround: Scoring relied on UIA tree dumps + control-coverage; not a migration defect (eval-side limitation, deferred to human).
